title: Budget categories and total trip cost
text: Build a per-person and group budget separately. Include lodging, intercity travel, local transfers, food, entry, guide/operator fees, taxes, tips, water, shopping and contingency. State what is an estimate and obtain current quotes; do not treat sample prices as live.

title: Transport trade-offs
text: Compare rail, state bus, private car and flights by total cost, door-to-door time, luggage, comfort and schedule flexibility. A low ticket price may exclude transfers or waiting time. Verify availability, class, fare and cancellation terms for the travel date.

title: Accommodation cost comparison
text: Compare total stay cost including taxes, meals, transfers, cancellation, extra beds and parking. Budget stays can be farther from attractions; include last-mile transport before comparing with a central property.

title: Activity and guide fees
text: At monuments and activities, check current entry, camera, guide, parking and special-event charges with the official venue/operator. Confirm whether a package includes transport, meals, equipment and taxes, and get the inclusions in writing.

title: Safari budget and permits
text: Wildlife permit costs, vehicle type, zones and booking rules depend on the reserve and date. Use official booking channels and distinguish permit cost from transport, guide, stay and meals. Never pay based on a promise of a particular animal sighting.

title: Desert experience packages
text: Compare desert packages by exact camp location, transfer, tent/bathroom type, meals, performance, animal activity and cancellation. Confirm taxes and whether the return journey is included. Package labels alone do not reveal quality or ethical standards.

title: Low-cost sightseeing choices
text: Balance paid monuments with public heritage streets, markets, lakeside walks and gardens where access is permitted. Verify whether a site is free, ticketed or restricted on the day; do not assume access from a map listing.

title: Travel contingency fund
text: Keep a contingency for delays, weather changes, local transfers and booking changes. The right amount depends on party size, itinerary and risk tolerance; separate emergency funds from planned spending.
